The Heritage Calendar

Athens Classic Marathon

March 15, 2026 · Athens, Greece

Trace the original marathon route from Marathon to Athens. Pass the Tomb of the Athenians and finish at the Panathenaic Stadium — the same marble arena that hosted the 1896 Olympics.

Rome Imperial Half

April 22, 2026 · Rome, Italy

A half-marathon weaving through the Forum, past the Colosseum, and along the Tiber. Aid stations in piazzas. The kind of run that makes you forget you're racing.

Edinburgh Castle Run

June 8, 2026 · Edinburgh, Scotland

From Arthur's Seat to the Royal Mile. Cobblestones, castles, and the kind of hills that humble you. Finishers receive a hand-forged medal from a local blacksmith.

Kyoto Temple Trail

October 3, 2026 · Kyoto, Japan

Wind through bamboo groves and past a thousand torii gates. The route connects 26 temples — one for each mile. Autumn leaves provide the only spectator color you need.

Washington Monument 10K

November 11, 2026 · Washington, D.C.

A Veterans Day tradition. From the Lincoln Memorial to the Capitol steps, past the reflecting pool. The most photographed 10K in America, and for good reason.

Havana Malecón Marathon

December 12, 2026 · Havana, Cuba

Twenty-six miles along the seawall. Salsa bands at every mile marker. Classic cars pace the leaders. A race that feels less like a competition and more like a celebration.

First-Timer Tips

Train for the Terrain

Every Heritage race has unique elevation. Edinburgh's hills are legendary. Rome's cobblestones demand ankle stability. Download the course-specific training plan 12 weeks out.

Arrive Two Days Early

Jet lag is a real factor. Arriving early lets you walk parts of the course, adjust to the climate, and soak in the city without the race-day pressure.

Respect the History

Our routes pass through sacred and protected sites. Stay on marked paths, follow marshal instructions at heritage zones, and remember: you're a guest of the city.
